newsitem.title: CANADA: Barrick confirms no overall Busang deal yet.
newsitem.headline: Barrick confirms no overall Busang deal yet.

text.p: Barrick Gold Corp confirmed statements from Bre-X Minerals Ltd on Wednesday that there were "several points" that remained to be cleared up in negotiations for the Busang gold deposit in Indonesia.
"Several points remain outstanding," Barrick spokesman Vince Borg said in a phone interview. "An overall deal has not been reached yet."
Borg did not say how substantial the remaining issues were or how long they would take to resolve.
"We will keep you apprised of any newsworthy developments," he said.
Bre-X said in a short statement earlier today that "although agreement has been reached" on matters raised by the Indonesian Ministry of Mines, "several points remain outstanding."
The Indonesian government had told Bre-X to form a joint venture with Barrick by December 4, with Barrick getting 75 percent of the rich Busang gold deposit and Bre-X getting 25 percent.
No new deadline had been set by the ministry, Bre-X said. The Calgary-based company said it was awaiting clarification from the government on the outstanding issues.
Borg said he did not know if a new deadline would be set.
"The deadline is a decision for the government to make," he said.
